title: Distribution-constrained maximum stopping of maximum type
abstract: arXiv:2610.01585v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We consider the distribution-constrained optimal stopping problem $\sup_{\tau\sim \mu} \mathbb E[B^*_\tau]$, where $\mu$ is a probability distribution on $\mathbb R_+$, and $(B^*_t)$ denotes the running maximum of a standard Brownian motion. This problem was introduced in Beiglbock et al. (PTRF, 2018), where a monotonicity principle is used to establish the optimal stopping time as the hitting time of a specific boundary.   In this paper, we characterize this boundary by a variational inequality. In the spirit of Cox et al. (PTRF, 2019), we provide a novel probabilistic representation for the variational inequality as a time-reversed optimal stopping problem. A key ingredient for proving the viscosity solution property and comparison principle is a quantitative estimate near the singular corner of the time-space domain, where the initial and boundary conditions are incompatible. translated_title: 分布约束下最大值过程的最优停止问题
translated_abstract: 我们考虑分布约束下的最优停止问题 $\sup_{\tau\sim \mu} \mathbb E[B^*_\tau]$，其中 $\mu$ 是 $\mathbb R_+$ 上的一个概率分布，$(B^*_t)$ 表示标准布朗运动的运行最大值过程。该问题由 Beiglbock 等人（PTRF, 2018）提出，他们利用单调性原理将最优停时刻画为某一特定边界的首次触及时间。在本文中，我们通过一个变分不等式来刻画这一边界。借鉴 Cox 等人（PTRF, 2019）的思路，我们为该变分不等式提供了一个新颖的概率表示，即将其转化为一个时间倒转的最优停止问题。证明黏性解性质与比较原理的一个关键要素，是在时空区域的奇异角点附近（即初值条件与边界条件不相容之处）建立的定量估计。随后，我们证明了由此得到的触及时间的最优性。
tldr: 本文通过变分不等式刻画了布朗运动最大值过程分布约束最优停止问题的最优停止边界，并为其提供了将其转化为时间倒转最优停止问题的新颖概率表示。
en_tdlr: This paper characterizes the optimal stopping boundary for the distribution-constrained optimal stopping problem of the Brownian running maximum via a variational inequality, and provides a novel probabilistic representation of it as a time-reversed optimal stopping problem.
